package cache

import "testing"

func TestBehavior(t *testing.T) {
	s := &sharedIndexInformer{}
	if err := s.HandleDeltas([]Delta{{Type: "Added", Object: "one"}, {Type: "Updated", Object: "two"}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(s.Values) != 2 || s.Values[0] != "one" || s.Values[1] != "two" {
		t.Fatalf("changed delta order: %v", s.Values)
	}
	if err := s.HandleDeltas([]Delta{{Type: "error", Object: "three"}}); err == nil || len(s.Values) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("changed error: %v %v", err, s.Values)
	}
}
